summary: P07 iteration 2 passes the keep gate. Job membership is a property of process creation (JOB_LIST in the same STARTUPINFOEXW as the HANDLE_LIST), provably preceding any user code — the suspended primary is the fresh job's only member before resume; grandchildren and a nested-job-creating descendant stay contained; terminate and daemon death (kernel kill-on-close) sweep the whole tree; full-tree death is proven by an empty member list with PID-reuse-fenced waits (primary handles released via settle so exited members retire). The supervisor seam now completes end-to-end: the journal's tree id and epoch are bound through the new default bind_durable_identity seam, the exact P01 nine-field envelope (digest-committed) is issued only after full-tree death with exited/terminated evidence labels, and both natural and cancelled runs reach Completed with readable redacted tails while unbound direct spawns keep synthesizing ids a supervisor rejects. An incompatible enclosing job refuses as Unsupported, never run-loose. Windows-only, no production service wiring, no V1Store journaling faked.
